question: By whose grace has the determination of the Kaula doctrine become known?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Knowledge arose by that lord's grace
The Kaula determination is now known
inference: The speaker knows the determination of the Kaula doctrine through the grace of the lord of Kaulas.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
